title: blob.rs: uses full crate paths for ClientError instead of imports
description: blob.rs uses full-qualified paths throughout: crate::error::ClientError::Http, crate::error::ClientError::InvalidHeaderValue, crate::client::JmapClient::check_auth_status, etc. client.rs imports these at the top (use crate::error::ClientError). The inconsistency makes blob.rs harder to read. Add 'use crate::error::ClientError' and 'use crate::client::JmapClient' (or 'use super::...' as appropriate) to blob.rs and rewrite the method bodies to use the short names. Suggested rewrite: add use statements at the top of blob.rs.
